unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U19: Separate company capacity from officer authority and internal procedure

payload.title: Ask which boundary was crossed
payload.core_explanation_md:
An act beyond the company constitutional capacity differs from an act within that capacity but outside a director authority. Under the described ultra vires doctrine, a company-capacity defect is not cured merely by all members ratifying the transaction. An internal authorisation defect needs its own analysis and cannot automatically be described as the same defect.

The source discusses tracing, recovery of property and personal consequences for misuse or breach of authority. These are remedy questions requiring facts and legal conditions, not a promise that every invalid borrowing becomes recoverable as an ordinary contract debt. Preserve the use and traceability of funds and the representation of authority rather than announcing that ultra vires means no remedy of any kind.

self_check.prompt_text: Can unanimous member approval alone cure an act beyond company capacity?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Not under the described company ultra vires rule.

payload.stem_md: A transaction is stipulated to be beyond company constitutional capacity. Members unanimously approve it afterwards. Which proposition follows from the described doctrine?

options.text_md: Approval necessarily makes it intra vires
No restitution or property question can ever arise
Member ratification alone does not cure the capacity defect
Every director necessarily committed a crime
options.explanation_md: The required facts are not established.

payload.stem_md: A borrowing is within company objects, but the officer lacked the required authority. Why identify the defect precisely?

options.text_md: Officer authority and company capacity have different legal consequences
options.explanation_md: Do not treat all irregularities as identical.

options.text_md: Every internal defect destroys company existence
Objects never matter to a borrowing
options.explanation_md: They remain part of capacity analysis.

options.text_md: The officer title alone proves every power

payload.correct_explanation_md: Do not treat all irregularities as identical.
